content.AGENTS.md:
## Documentation discipline

- Update `.agents/project_management/project_description.md` when architecture, data flow, source ownership, build/deploy commands, security behavior, or major reusable UI conventions change.
- Do not use project description as a task log; task state belongs in the tracker.
- Read `.agents/project_management/lessons-learned.md` before implementation. Add only reusable root-cause lessons, never typo-level or one-off notes.
- Keep links and referenced paths valid after moves.
